name: model-dispatch-advisor
description: Present shared model/harness quota snapshots and persist explicit user selection preferences scoped by functional group.

interface.shortDescription: Quota snapshots & user selection preferences for AI dispatch

tools.name: dispatch_advisor_recommend
tools.description: Read available shared quota snapshots (remaining quota, source, readAt/resetsAt, and unknown states) alongside the user’s latest saved selection preference for a functional scope. Presents facts to the AI without computing a winner, ranking candidates, or mutating profiles and defaults.

group.description: Functional scope key to look up saved user selection preferences (for example "implementation"). Omit to inspect all saved functional scopes.

includeAllGroups.description: When true, include all saved functional scope preferences even when a specific group is requested.

targets.description: Optional exact identifiers (modelId, engineId, pool, window, or accountId) to filter quota readings and connected models.

engineIds.description: Optional exact harness engine IDs (for example "agy-cli" or "grok-acp") to filter quota readings.

accountIds.description: Optional exact quota account IDs to filter quota readings.

includeModels.description: When true, also include raw connected model entries from context.models.list() (filtered by targets when provided).

tools.name: dispatch_preference_update
tools.description: Save, read, or clear explicit user-stated selection preferences for a functional scope in this plugin’s own data store. Saving requires userAuthorized=true and userQuote/sourceNote; model-inferred guesses are rejected and profiles/defaults are never modified.

action.description: set saves or replaces the preference for one functional group; clear removes one group or all saved preferences; get reads stored preferences.

group.description: Functional scope key (for example "implementation"). Required for set and single-group clear.

clearAll.description: When action="clear" and clearAll=true, clears all saved functional scope preferences.

prefer.description: User-stated preferred targets or labels within this functional scope.

avoid.description: User-stated targets or labels to use less within this functional scope.

note.description: Optional concise scope or condition note from the user instruction.

userAuthorized.description: Must be true when action="set": confirms the preference comes from an explicit user instruction rather than agent self-inference.

userQuote.description: Verbatim user instruction or concise summary of what the user stated (for example "现在 GPT 少用一点").

sourceNote.description: Optional provenance anchor such as session/turn reference.
